Preserve original pale/dim hierarchy and every small old source mark. Strongest native source RGBA[247, 247, 247, 255] at original native[231, 60]; all source alpha/paint boundaries remain at original normalizedUV. Uncertain tiny paint marks remain equally indistinct soft paint, never interpreted as new letter, screw, rivet, bead, button, hole or raised plate.

HD improvement ONLY finer original handpaint transitions and understated native pigment. Preserve existing wood/metal paint palette and sourceblur scale. NO photographic woodgrain/metal abrasion/pores/coarsegrain/new scratches/woodrings/knots/checkergrid/engravedgrip/threadweave/polished reflective machining/new hardware/raisedrelief/glossybevel/new whiteglints/new rivets/straps/screws/regularized geometry/stronger outlines. Tiny seams/stripes remain exact old number/spacing/phase/localsoftcontrast.

Output ONLY the SAME ENTIRE opaqueRGB 3:1 helper canvas; original4:1 normalized UV is represented by the whole affine and will be inverted to1024x256 after generation. Keep every reference field at the same normalized coordinate; do not change framing or island positions. NO padding/letterbox/whitemargins/crop/zoom/recenter/registration/UVfitting/UVrepack/BBox/new parts/photo. Keep entire source A/black support/material/nativepaintscale/blur.
